tools.name: calculate_pool_salt
tools.description: Estimate swimming pool salt addition in pounds and bags from measured salt ppm and a user-supplied target. Includes high-salt dilution guidance and retest cautions. No equipment control.

tools.name: calculate_pool_volume
tools.description: Estimate swimming pool volume in US gallons and liters from rectangular, round, oval, or surface-area dimensions in feet or meters. Includes turnover flow, not equipment sizing.
